import logging
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, sys.argv[1])

import envconfig


class PrintHandler(logging.Handler):
    def emit(self, record):
        print("LOG", record.levelname, record.getMessage())


envconfig.log.addHandler(PrintHandler())
envconfig.log.propagate = False

envs = [
    {},
    {"APP_PORT": "9000", "APP_WORKERS": "16", "APP_DEBUG": "TRUE"},
    {"APP_PORT": "http", "APP_WORKERS": "many"},
    {"APP_PORT": "0", "APP_WORKERS": "-3"},
    {"APP_PORT": " 81 ", "APP_WORKERS": "2.5"},
]
for env in envs:
    print(env, envconfig.read_port(env), envconfig.read_workers(env), envconfig.read_debug(env))
print("ok")
